verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a feedback widget whose submissions land in the organization's Feedback list or a chosen project, with triage that dismisses spam. That gives a central intake repository for end-user feedback. Nothing shows the repository is searchable, or that it captures requests from colleagues alongside customers. Missing for 10: documented search over the feedback repository, intake of internal colleague requests into the same repository, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Leave the project unset and submissions arrive in your organization's Feedback list instead
Your users press it, describe a problem, and send — without leaving the page or filing anything anywhere.
Spam is dismissed here and goes no further.
